summary: Senior Credit Investments, LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare a cash distribution of $17.0106 per unit, payable on June 18, 2026 to unitholders of record as of May 29, 2026. The distribution is a return of capital to common unitholders. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are mentioned; the filing is a straightforward announcement of a periodic distribution. This is a capital return event by the issuer. Which to watch: the distribution amount relative to prior periods and the sustainability of payout levels.
